reason: A runtime host for loading, updating, and removing DeepSeek Harness Web client plugins from a local hot directory without restarting the web host.

summaries.zh: 用于从本地热插件目录运行时加载、更新和移除 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端插件，无需重启 Web 主机。
summaries.en: Loads, updates, and removes DeepSeek Harness Web client plugins at runtime from a local hot-plugin directory without restarting the web host.

capabilities: Reads and monitors a local hot-plugin directory
Serves plugin listings, bundles, and server-sent events over web routes
Dynamically executes client plugin bundles in every open page
Provides dynamically loaded plugins access to the client-side service environment
